description.en: A fresh parsley salad with tomato, mint and bulgur.
description.ro: O salată proaspătă de pătrunjel cu roșii, mentă și bulgur.
description.ar: سلطة بقدونس طازجة مع الطماطم والنعناع والبرغل.

ingredients: 1/4 cup fine bulgur, soaked in water for 15 minutes and drained
steps: Squeeze the soaked bulgur dry and put it in a bowl.
Add the parsley, mint, tomatoes and spring onions.
Dress with the lemon juice and olive oil, season, and toss gently.
Rest for 10 minutes and serve with crisp lettuce leaves.
